test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'attrect.'**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Out of all the options, 'attrect' is the incorrect word.
 
• The correct spelling is Attract**.
 
• The meaning of 'Attract' is to pull or draw someone or something towards them, by the qualities they have, especially good ones.
 
 
• Example:* These flowers are brightly coloured in order to **attract **butterflies.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'attrect.'
